Anthropic Messages requires max_tokens. When the caller sets no cap, the gateway sends the model catalog maximum (unknown models: 8192, plan 3.7) instead of the legacy SDK per-model default (4096 / 32000). It is a ceiling; billing is per generated token.

Explicitly disabled thinking: pi sends thinking:{type:"disabled"} where legacy omitted the field; identical API semantics (P1 allowlist item 2).

A thinking budget equal to the capability's disable value (0) turns thinking off; legacy sent the contradictory 'enable thinking with budget 0' (P1 allowlist item 4, now also for Gemini and Lemonade).

Claude 5 managed effort: pi also sends the effort as a mid-conversation output_config control entry (beta). The effective effort (last control entry) is compared and equals the requested one.
mode:'enabled' on a model whose reviewed default effort is 'none' now sends the lowest real effort; legacy sent effort 'none' (thinking stayed off although the user enabled it).

Gemini 2.5 thinking on without a chosen budget is the dynamic budget: legacy sent thinkingBudget:-1, the gateway omits the budget (same API meaning).

Plan 3.6: grok moves from Chat Completions to pi xai (OpenAI Responses API): /v1/responses, developer role, max_output_tokens, input items instead of messages, no stream_options. Thinking effort is compared separately.
Legacy MiniMax adapter only implemented the disable switch, so 'enabled' sent nothing; the gateway now sends thinking:{type:'enabled'} with the default budget.
